I'm a senior lecturer
at the [Department of Multilingualism and Foreign Language Education](https://www.unifr.ch/pluriling/en/) 
at the University of Fribourg in Switzerland.
In 2024, I obtained a Bachelor's degree in computer science
from the University of Bern,
where I'm currently pursuing a Master's degree in statistics.

I'm also a saxophonist with [Beat Moustache](https://beatmoustache.ch), 
a ska-pop band that mostly plays original songs in the Bernese dialect.

## Employment
2017--present: Senior lecturer, Department of Multilingualism and Foreign Language Teaching, University of Fribourg (CH)

2014--2017: Lecturer, Department of Multilingualism and Foreign Language Teaching, University of Fribourg (CH)

2010: Research assistant, Scandinavian Department, University of Groningen (NL)

2009: Internship, Scandinavian Department, University of Groningen (NL)

## Education
2024--...: M.Sc. Statistics and data science, University of Bern (CH)

2020--2024: B.Sc. Computer science with a minor in mathematics, University of Bern (CH)

2010--2014: Ph.D., University of Fribourg (CH)

2008--2010: M.A. European linguistics, University of Freiburg (D)

2004--2007: B.A. English and Swedish linguistics and literature, Ghent University (B)
